units.source_text: 马咯的话让我联想到了宗教。

en.t: Maro's words made me think of religion.

units.source_text: 我无疑是个坚定的唯物主义者，从未严肃认真的考虑过宗教问题。

en.t: I was undoubtedly a firm materialist, and had never seriously considered religious questions.

units.source_text: 此时我被托喀的死触动，就开始思考河童的宗教究竟是什么。

en.t: At that moment, moved by Tokka's death, I began to wonder what religion among the kappas really was.

units.source_text: 我当时马上问学生拉卟、。

en.t: I immediately asked the student Rapu.
